about: compiler/build mutants covering toolchain identity, action keys, gomod limits, pinsets, embed safety, store/locks, slots, root test guard, cache/lease/exec verification, trim bounds, and parallel wave planning

mutants.name: selfhost-build-toolchain-drop-exe-digest
mutants.rule: CompilerIdentityKey must include the compiler executable digest so different compiler binaries never share cache entries.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-input-unsorted-files
mutants.from: slices.SortFunc(out, func(a FileDigest, b FileDigest) int { strings.Compare(a.Path, b.Path) })
mutants.rule: CanonicalFiles must sort file digests by path so file input order never changes ActionKey.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-gomod-ignore-version-limit
mutants.rule: ResolveModuleGraph must reject go.mod versions exceeding the pinned Go toolchain release.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-pin-unsorted-key
mutants.rule: PinKey must sort entries before hashing so lock entry ordering is canonical.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-embed-allow-hidden
mutants.rule: matchEmbedPattern must skip dot- and underscore-prefixed hidden files unless prefixed with all: or explicitly named.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-store-overwrite-if-missing
mutants.rule: WriteAtomicIfMissing must return false without overwriting when the target path already exists.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-locks-ignore-busy
mutants.rule: Acquire must refuse conflicting exclusive locks on the same lock path with LockBusy.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-slot-ignore-busy-lock
mutants.to:
case LockBusy:
			LockHandle{Path: lockPath, Token: uint64(0), Exclusive: true}
mutants.rule: AcquireSlot must skip busy slots instead of granting two callers the same build slot.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-root-allow-user-cache-in-test
mutants.rule: ResolveRoot must refuse falling back to the shared user cache directory when running under a Go test without ERGO_CACHE.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-cache-skip-digest-verify
mutants.rule: VerifyModule must check the SHA-256 digest of archived bytes before admitting a cached module hit.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-trim-evict-leased
mutants.rule: TrimPass must never evict cache entries covered by an active lease.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-plan-skip-wave-order
mutants.rule: PlanBuild must assign each action to its topological dependency wave so dependencies execute strictly before dependents.
